description: This file is a shell script ('size_compare.sh') used for comparing the sizes of OpenWrt packages against upstream versions. It includes logic for fetching package index data, reading configuration files, and calculating size differences for various packages to analyze the storage impact of custom modifications.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays help information extracted from the script comments.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size (either installed size or package size) of a specific package from a given index file.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Main function that iterates over packages, compares local and upstream sizes, and outputs the differences.
